semiconductor_relevance: Medium — igus provides motion plastics products that are used in dynamic applications within the semiconductor value chain, particularly in automation and cleanroom environments.
summary: igus Taiwan Company Limited specializes in motion plastics products such as energy chain systems and chainflex cables, which are used in dynamic applications across the semiconductor industry. Their products are made from tribo-optimized polymers, offering benefits like reduced maintenance and environmental impact.
